content:
sarah: Heads up — planning a small infra apply during the change window tonight at 23:00 PT. Scope: increase NAT GW autoscale + tighten a service-role IAM policy. Will run a staging canary, then serial prod applies across 3 AZs. @mike @lina can you confirm no conflicting cutovers?

mike: good call. i'm free for the window. quick question — which provider version are we pinning? last provider upgrade caused drift.

sarah: pinning aws provider to 4.75.0 in `provider.tf`. also pinning module `networking/vpc` to v2.3.1 in the lockfile. added to the release notes: https://go/release/infra-2026-03-21

lina: looks fine from apps side. i'll pause any outgoing schema deploys between 23:00-23:40. i'll also watch traffic metrics for the canary. :eyes:

ash: preflight plan looks clean. I left a tiny nit in the IAM change — using `sts:AssumeRole` condition should include `aws:SourceAccount`. I'll push a patch in a minute.

sarah: thanks ash. i merged the fix at commit `c4f2b9a`. deploybot, can you run the preflight now?

deploybot: deploybot: running preflight checks for thread 1829000001 — terraform plan (staging) -> success. drift check passed. locking state.

mike: suggestion — run the staging canary with `--stagger 2m` to give metrics time to settle. also enable `--kv-cache=true` for the model serving customers in us-west.

sarah: agreed. plan for sequence: 1) staging canary (23:00-23:05) 2) wait 10m metrics 3) serial prod applies (AZ1, AZ2, AZ3) with 5m gaps. rollback criteria: >1% 5xx or control plane errors or any DSC alerts. If hit, STOP and rollback to commit `c4f2b9a^`.

oncall-bot: reminder: scheduled change window 2026-03-21 23:00 PT. Pager rotations: tim oncall.

tim: i'm nearby. will monitor CloudWatch alarms and ready to escalate. Make sure runbook is pinned in the thread.

sarah: runbook snippet added:
```
# rollback steps
1. deploybot abort --thread 1829000001
2. deploybot rollback --commit c4f2b9a^ --targets module.natgw,module.iam
3. terraform state unlock
4. notify @all and open incident channel
```

lina: i'll run the synthetic traffic checks during the canary (auth/login tier + upload path). will post baseline graphs.

mike: small ask — can we snapshot route tables before the prod apply? last time a route change caused a cross-AZ reconnect. `aws ec2 create-route-table-backup` is not a thing so i'll export via aws-cli and attach to the release notes.

sarah: done — backup file uploaded to the release doc. link above.

deploybot: staging canary apply started at 2026-03-21T23:00:30Z. Plan: apply module.networking (staging).

lina: staging canary looks green after 3m. latency + error rates within normal. posted graphs: https://go/graphs/canary-1829000001

mike: agree green. recommend proceed to prod AZ1.

sarah: starting prod AZ1 apply now with `deploybot apply --serial --az AZ1 --stagger 5m`. Will DM when each step completes.

deploybot: prod AZ1 apply finished: success. No errors.

oncall-bot: health check: auth 200/2m, storage 200/2m, egress 0 alerts.

sarah: moving to AZ2 in 10m. if anyone sees a spike, react with :warning: to this thread and i'll abort.

mike: noticed a tiny increase in 502s (~0.3%) in AZ1, but inside baseline. monitoring.

lina: saw a small spike on upload path right when AZ1 finished, it recovered in 90s. still within rollout tolerance.

sarah: starting AZ2.

deploybot: prod AZ2 apply finished: FAILED. Error: iam role update conflicted (service `batch-processor` still assumes old role). Plan output shows `12/28` resources changed, 1 error.

mike: oof. that's outside tolerance. roll it back.

sarah: aborting further applies. deploybot, initiate rollback to `c4f2b9a^` and unlock state when done. Also open incident channel.

deploybot: acknowledged. running: deploybot rollback --commit c4f2b9a^ --targets module.natgw,module.iam. Rollback started.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-031-72. Pager duty alerted. Tim oncall acknowledged.

tim: investigating service `batch-processor` config in AZ2. looks like a lifecycle hook prevented role replacement. i'll patch and validate in staging.

sarah: thanks tim. once tim confirms fix, we'll re-run canary in staging and then a cautious prod retry later tonight or early morning. I'll update release notes and notify customers.

mike: since this touched IAM, let's add an integration test to the CI that attempts role rotation in a sandbox. file an issue in infra repo.

sarah: created issue: https://go/issues/INFRA-1312. closing this thread for active deploy. I'll post a follow-up when staging canary passes. Thanks all. :heart:
